_comment: Starter design catalog. Loaded by backend/seed_designs.py (idempotent; matched by name or a previous name in 'aliases'). Every image is a real photograph, named <category>-<design number>-<4 digits>.jpg by catalog/name_images.py and listed in 'image', 'more_images' and 'closeups'; sourced from Pexels under the Pexels License (free commercial use, no attribution required) - see each design's 'photo'. Never imply the people shown endorse AryaVeda or are AryaVeda artists. A design with 'photo_needed' has no good photo yet and stays hidden - see catalog/PHOTO_GUIDE.md. 'style', 'coverage' and 'occasions' use the values in app/schemas/catalog.py.
